question.text: For transmission without nomination where the market value in each deceased account does not exceed Rs. 15,00,000, what documents must the claimant submit along with the attested copy of the Will?

answer.text: Letter of Indemnity on non-judicial stamp paper and an Affidavit

explanation.text: The Logic: Along with the attested copy of the Will, the claimant must submit (a) a Letter of Indemnity on appropriate non-judicial stamp paper and (b) an Affidavit. This applies where the market value in each deceased account does not exceed Rs. 15,00,000. The Trap: 'Only a self-declaration' is insufficient. The simplified document set with indemnity and affidavit is conditional on the Rs. 15,00,000 threshold per deceased account. Note: If the value exceeds the Rs. 15,00,000 limit, the documentation requirements escalate beyond the indemnity-and-affidavit route.
